guards.finding: Same-title deployments can differ materially in whether bubble state persists. Public AP analysis documents persistent-state versions, while UK-player reports describe versions where bubbles do not persist to the next spin or persistent features clear after cashout/idle conditions.

sources.use: Confirms variable-state/persistent-bubble mechanic exists in analyzed deployment.
Documents UK-version reports where bubbles do not persist and notes persistent features can be configured to clear after cashout/idle state.
Documents reports that UK variants of US persistent-state games can have the persistent feature removed.

guards.finding: A hard ceiling makes cost bounded, but meter closeness alone is insufficient for exact EV. Different games can use materially different hidden-trigger distributions, so midpoint assumptions are not universal.

sources.use: Explains standard MHB ceiling/floor math and explicitly conditions midpoint spend on a uniform-trigger assumption.
Warns that trigger distributions can differ by manufacturer and may cluster near the cap.
Warns against assuming a meter at a high percentage of the cap is automatically positive EV when trigger behavior may be concentrated near the top.
